units.source_text: 我只能认为所有这一切都是遥远的事件。

en.t: I could only think of all this as something that had happened far away.

units.source_text: 感觉迟钝的人要不是流血，就不会感到狼狈不堪。

en.t: A person with dull senses does not feel utterly wretched and bewildered unless blood is shed.

units.source_text: 然而，一旦流血时，悲剧也就结束了。

en.t: Yet once blood is shed, the tragedy is already over.

units.source_text: 不觉间，我竟迷迷糊糊入梦了。

en.t: Before I knew it, I had drifted hazily into sleep.

units.source_text: 一觉醒来，我被大家遗忘了。

en.t: When I woke, everyone had forgotten me.
All around me were filled with smoky traces of little birds.

units.source_text: 朝阳深深地直接射在枫树下方的枝板上。

en.t: The morning sun shone deeply and directly onto the branch boards beneath the maple trees.

units.source_text: 像白骨堆似的建筑物从地板下面承受着日光，仿怫复苏了。

en.t: The building, like a pile of white bones, received the sunlight from beneath the floor and seemed to come back to life.

units.source_text: 空御堂寂静而自豪地伸向枫树林覆盖的峡谷。

en.t: The empty hall stretched quietly and proudly toward the gorge covered in maple woods.
